name: BOUYGUES S.A. Actions Port. EO
summary: Bouygues S.A. is a French industrial group operating in construction, media, telecommunications, and real estate. Headquartered in Paris, France, Bouygues operates through its various subsidiaries, including Bouygues Construction, Bouygues Telecom, and TF1. The company provides a wide range of services from building infrastructure to providing telecommunications services and broadcasting media content.
